print.installTitle: How to install the shop's printer
installSteps: On the Windows PC connected to the receipt printer, open Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Printers & scanners (or Control Panel > Devices and Printers) and note the receipt printer's name, e.g. POS80 or XP-80C
Type that name in Printer name above exactly (letter case and spaces included) and press Save
Open this page on that PC, press Printer setup, then Confirm — a zip file downloads
Unzip it, right-click INSTALL.bat and choose Run as administrator
When it finishes the status above turns green, Online — try Print receipt on any deposit
Changing printers later? Just change the name and save; the PC uses the new name within about a minute, no reinstall
print.printerNameHelp: Must match the printer name on the Windows PC exactly — see How to install the shop's printer below. Save it before pressing Printer setup
